name: CSAR 2011-2012 Benchmark
description: Measures docking accuracy and relative ranking performance of methods on blinded congeneric series for molecular docking.
evaluation_method: pose_accuracy (RMSD-based success rate) and ranking performance (ROC-AUC / enrichment)
general_score_metric: docking success rate (e.g., fraction with RMSD < 2 Å) and ranking metrics (AUC/enrichment)
typical_sota_score: varies widely by target and protocol; typical reported docking success rates often fall in the ~20–60% range (RMSD < 2 Å)
reputation: A well-known, historically important community benchmark for evaluating docking and ranking on blinded congeneric series; cited and used in computational chemistry but considered dated and limited in size compared with modern datasets.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on molecular docking; relatively small and dated compared to modern datasets, target-dependent performance, and potential bias from congeneric series; useful for controlled method comparisons but not representative of all real-world discovery scenarios.
